Photo editing guides

How to remove a photo background for free

Start with a sharp image where the subject is visually separate from the background. Upload it to the tool and inspect hair, hands and narrow gaps after processing. Choose transparent PNG when you want to reuse the subject in another design. Use JPG only after adding a solid, gradient or photo background.

Make small brightness, contrast and saturation changes. Extreme enhancement can make a photo look artificial.

Background tips for product photos

Use a simple white or neutral background for the main listing image unless the marketplace requests something different. Keep the same framing and background across a product range, leave balanced space around each item and preserve natural edges around straps, handles and fabric.

Editing should improve clarity without changing product color, proportions or features.

How to prepare a clean ID photo

Use even lighting, hold the camera at eye level and choose a plain background. Avoid strong shadows, beauty filters and face reshaping. Official requirements vary, so always check the current dimensions, background color, file format and head placement on the issuing authority’s website.
